turns.doctor_question: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. Thank you for coming in today. What brings you to the clinic?
turns.patient_response:
Hi, Dr. [Name]. I... well, it's a lot, to be honest. I guess what really brought me in is that things have been getting incredibly strange at the shop. I'm an auto service tech, a mechanic, and I've been working in garages for years after I took some college classes and realized I just preferred working with my hands. Garages are really loud places, you know? You've got the air compressors, the impact wrenches, the bay doors opening and closing, radios going. But lately, cutting through all of that noise... I keep hearing this man's voice. 

And it's not any of the guys I work with. It comes directly out of the garage vents. And then sometimes, when I pull a vehicle into my bay and pop the latch, the voice comes from right under the hood. I know how it sounds, but it is as clear as somebody standing right next to me. Clearer than you and me talking right now, just a completely real man's voice right in my ear. 

And he just talks to me, mostly warnings. He keeps telling me not to trust my husband, which is really messing with my head because I go home and I'm just looking at him wondering what he's done, why this man in the vents is warning me about him. And then at work, the voice will specifically tell me not to touch certain cars. Like, I'll get a work order for a brake job, and I'll walk up to the car, and the voice just says, 'Do not touch it.' So I don't. I can't. My boss is getting furious because I'm refusing tickets and stalling out my bay, and my husband is the one who basically made me come here today because he says I'm not making sense, but I just... I don't know how to explain to them how real this guy's voice is.
